claims.text: MCCTIL states that the Incorporated Societies Act, enacted in 1988, does not support online filing. The online register it deployed in December 2025 takes filings for companies, business names, business licences and foreign-investment certification. Incorporating a society currently requires a paper application signed by five members of the proposed society, with two copies of its rules.
claims.uncertainty: Describes registry practice as at the memo date. It names no society or political party and does not say whether any political organization is registered as a society. Because the online register does not take society filings, it was not searched for PTOA.
